'''Mason Johnson Revenenge of the Jedi''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Mason Johnson]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14321">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14321 Revenenge of the Jedi], DeckTech (Mason "Palleon" Johnson, 6 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14321/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14321/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018035314/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14321/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mason Johnson]]
* '''Published:''' 6 March 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Revenenge of the Jedi''

== Original post ==

'''Revenenge of the Jedi'''
* '''Author:''' Mason "Palleon" Johnson
* '''Published:''' March 6, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' New Age Hidden Mains that Drains, Battles, Retrieves, and Wins. It's Undefeated in my local tournament's. 12-0 so far

=== Strategy ===

==== Starting ====

Start Hidden Base, Rendezous Point, and Corellia as you Indicator. Use HFTMF to start Insurrection, Staging Areas, and Menace Fades, or Do or Do Not & Wise Advice if you suspect SAC.

Playing Pull your docking bays and systems and get you characters down for an early drain, then Beat them down wherever they are, and make them lose tons to battle Damage. If you lose any force retrieve it and you should win.

This deck is brand new so I don't know the matvhups, but they will be added after I tak ethis to the Vegas DPC

Thanks
